events.description: Omniscient announced the new Vouch system will finally be activated, alongside a complete reputation reset; administrator reputation will no longer be visible. He is considering keeping a backup of old reputations to be viewable after reset.
The Mentors usergroup now moderates more subforums.
Administrator profile activity is now hidden; visitors only see 'Unknown location' on admin profiles.
Non-upgraded members can no longer use images in their signatures; l33t or Ub3r is required.
Tiny-Pic, an image host that deletes images linked from HF, has been censored after Rhythm pointed out that uppit was already censored but Tiny-Pic was not.
Omniscient warned that PMing him to draw attention to a Suggestions and Ideas thread will get the account repfucked, banned, and 'ripped open like a can of tuna.'
User News is being moved to the Misc. editions, and a new Opinion section is being added to the main edition where users can submit their thoughts on a weekly topic.
